purpose: Automatic public-reference evaluation; no further user transcription requested

model.decoding: greedy auto language plus mixedcode, no hints, no references in prompt

hiacc.credit: Shruti Singh, HiACC: Hinglish Adult & Children Code-switched corpus, https://zenodo.org/records/15551669
hiacc.policy: all664 adult_test rows; whole clips 3..20s, Latin and Devanagari reference; sha256 suite-public-hinglish-v1:id order; max5 per pid; first50; frozen before inference

svarah.policy: 3..25 seconds inclusive; >=5 strict reference words; hash order within full demographic profile; language-round-robin profile order; at most2perprofile; first120; no explicit speaker/style ID available
svarah.selection: first20 of existing frozen120 cases, before Trelis inference

semantic_gate: not certified; WER is not critical-fact fidelity

runtime.legacy_runner_metadata_note: Copied runtime runner has placeholder wer:null and checked_reference_available:false; these are not quality results. Actual public-reference scoring is in scores above.

normalization.strict: whitespace split with case and punctuation intact
normalization.script_safe: Unicode NFC, casefold, Unicode punctuation/symbols to space, collapse whitespace; preserve combining marks; no transliteration or numeral rewrite
normalization.english_normalized: Whisper EnglishTextNormalizer with checkpoint normalizer.json; ONLY Indian English
normalization.aggregate: sum S+D+I / sum reference words, not average clip WER
normalization.semantic_gate: not certified automatically; no model-as-judge or agreement ground truth

reference_id_mapping_correction: During inference, corrected20 Svarah reference join IDs overwritten by source metadata during preparation; reference strings, selected audio, order and scoring unchanged; no predictions inspected.
limitations: Only20 Indian-English clips and50 HiACC clips; no confidence claim or full release acceptance.
HiACC is an author-used public evaluation surface; train/development contamination not ruled out.
Different domain from Meet; no speaker attribution, long-form capture, silence, noise or overlap certification.
Keep publisher references unchanged: script variation, typos, possible incomplete annotations affect WER.
One high insertion-error case cannot be called invented speech without checking audio.
Private meeting references are not replaced by model agreement or model judges.
decision: Keep Trelis as provisional recognition candidate; English sample gate passes, mixed/source-fidelity release gates remain unresolved; rollout remains disabled.
